Title: General availability: Azure Cognitive Search implements debug sessions

Body.Content:
Debug sessions is a visual editor that works with an existing skillset in the Azure portal. Debus sessions expose the structure and content of a single enriched document as it's produced by an indexer and skillset, for the duration of the session. As you work with a live document, the session is interactive allowing you to identify errors, modify and invoke skill execution, and validate the results in real time. You can also commit changes to skillsets and publish them to their service. 

For additional information, please read our documentation.
